knowledge:
- key_parameters: read.context=Specifies the sequence context in which methylation information is read from aligned files ("CpG" or "All") ;; no_overlap=Logical indicating whether to avoid overlapping reads during methylation calling ;; Scorefun=Function used for smoothing methylation levels in mCsmoothing ("sum" or "mean") ;; Nbins/nbins=Number of bins to divide genomic regions into for smoothing or profiling ;; group=Vector specifying the group name for each sample in a BSdataSet ("C" for Control, "E" for Experiment) ;; mcClass/MCClass/mcCLASS=The sequence context class of interest (e.g., 'mCG', 'mCHG', 'mCHH') ;; dmrSize=Minimum number of cytosines required to define a DMR in findDMR ;; dmrBp=Maximum distance in base pairs between adjacent cytosines to be considered in the same DMR ;; type=Type of DMRs to consolidate in consolidateDMRs ("hyper" or "hypo")
- alternatives: compEpiTools=Mentioned as a complementary package for generating/manipulating genomic regions and performing integrative heatmap visualization (heatmapdata, heatmapPlot) ;; ListerEtAlBSseq=A data package containing base-resolution Bisulfite sequencing data used for demonstration
- when_to_use: Use this package when you have base-resolution DNA methylation data (such as WGBS or RRBS) and need to perform memory-efficient profiling, sample correlation, and DMR identification across CpG and non-CpG contexts.
- pitfalls: BSprepare requires a local installation of the tabix software to compress and index flat files ;; To save memory, methylPipe only stores C positions with at least 1 mC read; unmethylated Cs are inferred by excluding uncovered regions (provided as a GRanges object) ;; findDMR only considers cytosine positions that are covered in all compared samples, so low-coverage regions may be excluded from DMR detection

workflows.name: database_preparation
workflows.intent: Process raw aligned files to generate tabular methylation calls and prepare tabix-indexed BSdata and BSdataSet objects.
input: test_methcall (folder containing sorted SAM files from BISMARK aligner)
H1_chr20_CG_10k.txt (tabular text file of methylation calls)
workflows.stages: 1. Call methylation from aligned files using meth.call ;; 2. Compress and index tabular files using BSprepare ;; 3. Create BSdata objects for individual samples ;; 4. Combine multiple BSdata objects into a BSdataSet
workflows.code:
file_loc <- system.file('extdata', 'test_methcall', package='methylPipe')
meth.call(files_location=file_loc, output_folder=tempdir(), no_overlap=TRUE, 
          read.context="CpG", Nproc=1)

file_loc <- system.file('extdata', 'H1_chr20_CG_10k.txt', package='methylPipe')
#BSprepare(files_location=file_loc,output_folder=file_loc, tabix="/path-to-tabix/")
uncov_GR <- GRanges(Rle('chr20'), IRanges(c(14350,69251,84185), c(18349,73250,88184)))
H1data <- system.file('extdata', 'H1_chr20_CG_10k_tabix_out.txt.gz', 
                      package='methylPipe')
H1.db <- BSdata(file=H1data, uncov=uncov_GR, org=Hsapiens)

IMR90data <- system.file('extdata', 'IMR90_chr20_CG_10k_tabix_out.txt.gz', 
                         package='methylPipe')
IMR90.db <- BSdata(file=IMR90data, uncov=uncov_GR, org=Hsapiens)
H1.IMR90.set <- BSdataSet(org=Hsapiens, group=c("C","E"), IMR90=IMR90.db, H1=H1.db)

workflows.name: methylation_profiling_and_visualization
workflows.intent: Profile absolute and relative DNA methylation levels across specific genomic regions of interest and visualize the profiles.
input: GR_chr20.Rdata (Rdata file containing a GRanges object of genomic regions)
gec.IMR90.Rdata (Rdata file containing a pre-computed GEcollection object)
workflows.stages: 1. Map methylation data to genomic ranges using mapBSdata2GRanges ;; 2. Profile absolute and relative methylation in bins using profileDNAmetBin to create a GEcollection ;; 3. Combine multiple GEcollection objects into a GElist ;; 4. Plot methylation profiles alongside gene annotations using plotMeth
workflows.code:
gr_file <- system.file('extdata', 'GR_chr20.Rdata', package='methylPipe')
load(gr_file)
resmC <- mapBSdata2GRanges(GenoRanges=GR_chr20, Sample=H1.db, context='CG')

gec.H1 <- profileDNAmetBin(GenoRanges=GR_chr20, Sample=H1.db, mcCLASS='mCG', nbins=3)
binmC(gec.H1)[4:5,]
binC(gec.H1)[4:5,]
binrC(gec.H1)[4:5,]

gec1 <- gec.H1[start(gec.H1) < 153924]
gec2 <- gec.H1[start(gec.H1) > 153924]

gecIMR_file <- system.file('extdata', 'gec.IMR90.Rdata', package='methylPipe')
load(gecIMR_file)
gel <- GElist(gecIMR90=gec.IMR90, gecH1=gec.H1)

library(TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg18.knownGene)
txdb <- TxDb.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg18.knownGene
gel <- GElist(gecIMR90=gec.IMR90[1:10], gecH1=gec.H1[1:10])
plotMeth(gel, colors=c("red","blue"), datatype=c("mC","mC"), yLim=c(.025, .025), brmeth=list(IMR90=IMR90.db, H1=H1.db),
         mcContext="CG", transcriptDB=txdb, chr="chr20", start=14350, end=277370, org=Hsapiens)

workflows.name: differential_methylation_analysis
workflows.intent: Identify and consolidate differentially methylated regions (DMRs) between experimental groups.
input: H1.IMR90.set (BSdataSet object containing control and experiment samples)
GR_chr20 (GRanges object defining the regions of interest)
workflows.stages: 1. Find candidate DMRs using findDMR ;; 2. Consolidate and filter DMRs based on p-value and distance thresholds using consolidateDMRs
workflows.code:
DMRs <- findDMR(object= H1.IMR90.set, Nproc=1, ROI=GR_chr20, MCClass='mCG',
     dmrSize=6, dmrBp=800)

hyper.DMRs.conso <- consolidateDMRs(DmrGR=DMRs, pvThr=0.05, GAP=100, type="hyper")
